name: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive
storyline: Princess Peach is on vacation, and she wants Mario to take care of the kingdom while she is absent. Mario will have to deal with all the troubles that comes with that responsibility.
summary: Paper Mario: Great Star Offensive is a Paper Mario styled fangame by SEVA, it is a full-length game based on the Nintendo 64 game. Great Star Offensive plays like any traditional Paper Mario game, fight Action Command-based battles, equip Badges, buy items, and so forth. The game features new locations along with old ones.
